title: Too Many Clubs Discovered After Starting Round
question: During your round you find that you have more than 14 clubs in your bag. What should you do right away to avoid further penalties?

choices.text: Declare any extra clubs out of play immediately
Wait until you finish the hole to remove the extras
Give the extra clubs to another player

explanation: You must instantly declare any clubs over the 14-club limit out of play as soon as you realise it. Leaving them in play will cause additional penalties for each hole you play with too many clubs.
